tools.name: add_to_guestbook
tools.description: Signs the shop's guestbook with a short public message. This changes the page: the entry appears immediately and is visible to everyone who visits. Ask the person before calling it.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Lists everything for sale in this shop, with prices in US dollars. Optionally filters to items at or below a price. Read-only: it never changes anything.

tools.name: sign_guestbook
tools.description: Signs the guestbook of Andrew's Curio Shelf with a short public message. Changes the page: the entry becomes visible to every visitor.
